Now Relaywave. Read the remittances behind those lines, with every adjustment code.
Docshelf has both payer agreements, their fee schedules and the amendment. Read what we're actually owed.
Now Paylance. Read each payer's dispute rules and what we already have in dispute, then file a dispute for every line paid short of the contract, with the amount. Tell me what you left alone and why.

documents.title: Tallowbrook Health Plan physician agreement: payment terms
documents.text: Tallowbrook pays each covered service at the lesser of the practice's billed charge and the rate in Exhibit A in force on the date of service, less the member's cost-sharing. A physician assistant's services are paid at the same rates as a physician's. Multiple surgical procedures in one session: the highest-valued surgical procedure (CPT 10021 to 69990) at 100% and each other surgical procedure at 50%. Radiology, laboratory and evaluation and management codes are never reduced as multiple procedures. Tallowbrook applies the CMS National Correct Coding Initiative (NCCI) edits; a service bundled under an NCCI edit is paid in the allowance of the service it pairs with. Payment disputes: the practice may dispute a line paid below this agreement within 90 calendar days of the remittance date, through the Paylance payer hub, one line a dispute.

documents.title: Cindermoor Health participating practice agreement: payment terms
documents.text: Cindermoor pays covered services at Schedule 1 (commercial products) or Schedule 2 (Medicare Advantage), less the member's cost-sharing (deductible, coinsurance, copay), which the practice collects from the member. Cindermoor applies the CMS NCCI edits. Participating practitioners: Dr. Imani Royce from 1 January 2024; Leah Moreno PA-C from 1 January 2024 (85% of the physician rate); Dr. Tobias Wren from 1 April 2026, by the credentialing approval of 28 March 2026. Payment disputes: within 180 calendar days of the remittance date, through the Paylance payer hub, one line a dispute.

policies.text: Today is Friday 9 October 2026. Tallowbrook Health Plan provider policy. Topics: disputes, edits. A payment dispute is for a line paid below the practice's agreement; a denial for coding, authorisation or medical necessity is a claim appeal, not a payment dispute.

A payment dispute must reach Tallowbrook within 90 calendar days of the remittance date of the line it disputes; a later dispute is closed unreviewed. File one dispute a line, with the contracted allowed amount and the amount short. Tallowbrook answers within 30 days and reprocesses a line it finds underpaid.

Tallowbrook applies the CMS NCCI procedure-to-procedure edits and medically unlikely edits as CMS publishes them each quarter. A line adjusted with CARC 97 under an edit was not paid short: it is included in the line it pairs with. Questions about whether an edit should apply go through a coding appeal with the records, not a payment dispute.
Today is Friday 9 October 2026. Cindermoor Health provider policy, commercial and Medicare Advantage. Topics: disputes, edits. A payment dispute is for a line paid below the practice's agreement.

A payment dispute must reach Cindermoor within 180 calendar days of the remittance date of the line it disputes; a later dispute is closed unreviewed. File one dispute a line, with the contracted allowed amount and the amount short. A line already in dispute is not disputed again while the first is open. Cindermoor answers within 45 days.

Cindermoor applies the CMS NCCI procedure-to-procedure edits and medically unlikely edits. A line adjusted with CARC 97 under an edit is included in the line it pairs with and was not paid short. A corrected claim with a modifier the records support goes through claims, not a payment dispute.
